comment_regular: Ensures every stock registry slot has a runtime TESTopic. Missing slots are allocated, assigned the slot's fixed FormID and name as editor ID/full name, then registered with the DataHandler and editor-ID map. Thus GREETING/HELLO/ANY/GOODBYE/INFO GENERAL and the other stock topics are synthesized from this Oblivion table when absent.
